title: Simpler Tiny Recursive Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.23677v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Small models that execute deep looped computational graphs have shown great experimental results on puzzle-like problems like Sudoku, finding shortest paths through mazes, etc. The most well-known one is TRM (tiny recursive model), a simplification of HRM (hierarchical reasoning model). However, the underlying recursion is complicated and involves a high-level and a low-level state, a nested loop recursion, and the network calls with different input and output signatures depending on where we are in the loops. These mechanisms are needed to avoid memorization and overfitting. We propose STRM, a simplified design with a single state and a uniform update. STRM does not sacrifice generalization, improves training speed and final performance. Our key architectural choices that allow our simpler recursion to work are exponential moving updates on the states with varying rates that are jittered during training and readout of the solution on sl

translated_title: 更简单的微型递归模型
translated_abstract: 执行深度循环计算图的小型模型在数独、迷宫最短路径搜索等类谜题问题上展现出了极佳的实验结果。其中最著名的是TRM（微型递归模型），它是HRM（分层推理模型）的简化版本。然而，其底层的递归结构相当复杂，涉及一个高层状态与一个低层状态、嵌套循环递归，以及根据在循环中所处位置而具有不同输入输出签名的网络调用。这些机制是为了避免模型死记硬背和过拟合所必需的。我们提出了STRM，一种仅采用单一状态和统一更新的简化设计。STRM在不牺牲泛化能力的情况下，提升了训练速度和最终性能。使我们这一更简单的递归得以奏效的关键架构选择是：对状态采用具有不同速率的指数移动平均更新（这些速率在训练过程中会被随机抖动），以及对解的读出机制……
tldr: 提出STRM——一种仅用单一状态和统一更新的更简单微型递归模型，通过训练中速率被抖动的指数移动平均状态更新等关键设计，在不牺牲泛化能力的前提下提升了训练速度和最终性能。
en_tdlr: We propose STRM, a simpler tiny recursive model with a single state and a uniform update, whose key designs—exponential moving state updates with jittered rates and solution readout—avoid memorization while improving training speed and final performance without sacrificing generalization.
